															Bihar STET 2026: Eligibility Criteria

															
																Secondary (Class-9th to 10th) Paper-I :- Bachelor Degree in Related with Subject with Minimum 50% Marks and B.Ed Exam Passed.  
																Senior Secondary (Class-11th & 12th) Paper-II :-  Post Graduate (PG)  Degree with Second Division in Related Subject and B.Ed Exam Passed. (For Computer Science Subject Candidates, B.Ed. Degree is Not Compulsory.). 
																Important Note:- In case of SC/ ST/ EBC/ BC & Divyang Will Be Given Relaxation Up to 5%.
																Degrees must be from UGC/NCTE-recognized institutions.
																Age/ Qaulfication for Other State Candidates (All Category) treated as General Caterory.
																Candidates must be Indian citizens.
															
															
														
														
														
		
																		
																		Bihar STET 2026: Paper/ Subject Wise Education Qualification Details

																		Paper I (For Secondary Level - Classes 9-10)

																		
																			
																			General Subjects (Code 101 to 112) :  Hindi (101), Urdu (102), Bangla (103), Maithili (104), Sanskrit (105), Arabic (106), Persian (107), Bhojpuri (108), English (109), Mathematics (110), Science (111), Social Science (112).

																			
																				
																				Qualification: Bachelor's Degree / Master's Degree in the concerned subject with minimum 50% marks and B.Ed. degree from an NCTE-recognized institution. (OR 45% marks in Graduation/PG as per NCTE 2002/2007 norms with B.Ed.) OR 4-Year integrated B.A.Ed / B.Sc.Ed degree in the specified subject.
																				
																			
																			
																			
																			Physical Education (Code 113)

																			
																				
																				Qualification: Bachelor's Degree in Physical Education (B.P.Ed) or Graduation with Physical Education as an elective subject with minimum 50% marks (45% for candidates with national/inter-university sports participation/coaching).
																				
																			
																			
																			
																			Music Teacher (Code 114)

																			
																				
																				Qualification: Bachelor’s Degree in Music (B.Mus) or equivalent with minimum 50% marks from a recognized University/Board.
																				
																			
																			
																			
																			Fine Arts Teacher (Code 115)

																			
																				
																				Qualification: Bachelor’s Degree in Fine Arts (B.F.A) or equivalent with minimum 50% marks from a recognized University/Board.
																				
																			
																			
																			
																			Dance Teacher (Code 116)

																			
																				
																				Qualification: Bachelor’s Degree in Dance or equivalent with minimum 50% marks from a recognized University/Board.
																				
																			
																			
																			
																			Special Education Teacher

																			
																				
																				Qualification: Graduation with minimum 50% marks + B.Ed. in Special Education (with valid CRR No. registered with RCI) + 6 Months Teaching Training in Cross Disability.
																				
																				
																				 
																				
																			
																			
																		

																		Paper II (For Higher Secondary Level - Classes 11-12)

																		
																			
																			General Subjects (Code 201 to 224 & 229) : Hindi (201), Urdu (202), English (203), Sanskrit (204), Bangla (205), Maithili (206), Magahi (207), Arabic (208), Persian (209), Bhojpuri (210), Pali (211), Prakrit (212), Mathematics (213), Physics (214), Chemistry (215), Zoology (216), History (217), Geography (218), Political Science (219), Sociology (220), Economics (221), Philosophy (222), Psychology (223), Home Science (224), Botany (229).

																			
																				
																				Qualification: Master's Degree (Post Graduation) in the specified subject with minimum 50% marks + B.Ed. degree from an NCTE recognized institution. (OR 45% marks in PG with B.Ed. as per NCTE 2002/2007 norms) OR BA.Ed / B.Sc.Ed OR Minimum 55% in PG with 3-Year Integrated B.Ed-M.Ed.
																				
																			
																			
																			
																			Commerce (Code 225)

																			
																				
																				Qualification: Master's Degree (M.Com) in Commerce with minimum 50% marks + B.Ed. degree. Eligible branches include Entrepreneurship (EPS), Accountancy, and Business Studies. (Note: M.Com in Applied/Business Economics is not eligible).
																				
																			
																			
																			
																			Computer Science (Code 226)

																			
																				
																				Qualification: DOEACC 'A' Level + Master's Degree OR B.E/B.Tech (CS/IT) OR B.E/B.Tech (Any stream) + Post Graduate Diploma in Computer OR M.Sc (CS) / MCA OR B.Sc (CS) / BCA + Post Graduate Degree in any subject OR DOEACC 'B' / 'C' Level + Graduation/PG.
																				
																				
																				Note: B.Ed. degree is not compulsory for Computer Science candidates.
																				
																			
																			
																			
																			Agriculture (Code 227)

																			
																				
																				Qualification: Graduation in Agriculture/Horticulture with minimum 50% marks + Master's Degree in Agronomy / Plant Breeding & Genetics / Entomology / Plant Pathology / Seed Science & Technology / Soil Science / Horticulture.
																				
																			
																			
																			
																			Music Teacher (Code 228) : 

																			
																				
																				Qualification: Master's Degree (M.Mus) in Music Education or equivalent with minimum 50% marks from a recognized University/Board.
																				
																			
																			
																		

																		Subject Group Details (PG Level Eligibility):

																		
																			
																			Physics: Physics / Electronics / Applied Physics / Nuclear Physics
																			
																			
																			Chemistry: Chemistry / Biochemistry
																			
																			
																			Economics: Economics / Applied Economics / Business Economics
																			
																			
																			Commerce: Master's Degree in Commerce (Applied/Business Economics excluded)
																			
																			
																			Botany / Zoology: Botany / Zoology / Life Science / Bio Science / Genetics / Micro Biology / Biotechnology / Molecular Biology / Plant Physiology
																			
																			
																			Mathematics: Mathematics / Applied Mathematics
																			
																		
																		
																	
														
															
															Bihar STET 2026 Exam Pattern

															
																Examination Type: CBT Mode
																All Question are Multiple Choice 
																There is no negative Marking
																Each question carry 1 Marks
																Total Number of Question: 150
																Total Marks: 150
																Duration: 150 Minutes 
															
															
														
														
															
															Bihar STET 2026 : प्रमाण पत्र अपलोड करना

															आप अपनी पात्रता साबित करने के लिए नीचे दिए गए प्रमाण पत्रों की स्व-सत्यापित (self-attested) प्रतियां अपलोड करें।

															
																
																मैट्रिक (10वीं) का प्रमाण पत्र और अंक पत्र (यह आपकी जन्म तिथि के लिए भी जरूरी है)।
																
																
																इंटर (12वीं) का प्रमाण पत्र और अंक पत्र।
																
																
																स्नातक का प्रमाण पत्र और अंक पत्र।
																
																
																स्नातकोत्तर का प्रमाण पत्र और अंक पत्र।
																
																
																बी.एड. का प्रमाण पत्र और अंक पत्र।
																
																
																यदि आपके पास कोई अन्य शैक्षणिक योग्यता है, तो उसका प्रमाण पत्र भी दें।
																
																
																सक्षम अधिकारी द्वारा जारी किया गया आवासीय प्रमाण पत्र।
																
																
																अनुसूचित जाति/अनुसूचित जनजाति के उम्मीदवारों के लिए सक्षम अधिकारी द्वारा जारी किया गया जाति प्रमाण पत्र।
																
																
																अत्यंत पिछड़ा वर्ग/पिछड़ा वर्ग के उम्मीदवारों के लिए सक्षम अधिकारी द्वारा जारी किया गया क्रीमीलेयर रहित प्रमाण पत्र।

																(नोट: आरक्षण का लाभ लेने वाली विवाहित महिलाओं का जाति और क्रीमीलेयर रहित प्रमाण पत्र उनके पिता के नाम और पते से जारी होना चाहिए, पति के नाम से नहीं।)
																
																
																यदि आप दिव्यांगता का दावा कर रहे हैं, तो सक्षम अधिकारी द्वारा जारी किया गया वैध दिव्यांग प्रमाण पत्र।
																
																
																भूतपूर्व सैनिक होने के कारण अधिकतम आयु सीमा में छूट पाने के लिए आपके पास भूतपूर्व सैनिक होने का प्रमाण पत्र होना चाहिए।
